Internal document · Owner: Customer Support · Last reviewed: 2 September 2026

## How to use this runbook

Every error shown to a Kestrel user carries a code of the form `KST-` followed by four digits. The first digit gives the area: 1 for sign-in, 2 for connectors, 3 for queries and dashboards, 4 for members and seats, 5 for delivery and embedding, 6 for billing.

For each code, this runbook gives what the user sees, the usual cause, what support can do, and when to escalate. Always ask the customer for the workspace name, the exact code and the time it happened. If a code is not listed here, escalate it to the on-call engineer of the Platform team.

Internal document · Owner: Platform team · Last updated: 15 September 2026

This catalog lists the production services of Kestrel, what each one does, and which team owns it. The owning team is responsible for the service's on-call rotation, its alerts and its runbook entries. When in doubt about who owns something, ask in #platform-help.

# Kestrel Analytics — Product Guide

Version 4.2 · Last updated: 12 August 2026 · Audience: customers and workspace administrators

## 1. What Kestrel does

Kestrel Analytics is a dashboard and business intelligence service for teams. You connect your data sources, build datasets on top of them, and turn those datasets into dashboards that refresh automatically. Dashboards can be shared with colleagues, sent as scheduled PDF reports, or embedded in your own web applications.

Everything in Kestrel lives inside a **workspace**. A workspace has members, connectors, datasets and dashboards. Most customers use one workspace per company; larger organisations sometimes create one workspace per department. # Kestrel Analytics — Billing and Refund Policy

Effective date: 1 January 2025 · Policy owner: Finance · Audience: customers and support staff

## 1. Scope

This policy explains how Kestrel Analytics charges for its plans, how invoices are issued, and when refunds are possible. It applies to all paid plans: Starter, Team, Business and Enterprise. Enterprise contracts may contain different terms; when they do, the contract takes precedence over this policy. Current prices are published on the Kestrel pricing page and are not repeated here.

## 2. Billing cycles

Paid plans are billed per seat, either monthly or annually. Monthly plans are charged on the same day each month as the original purchase. Annual plans are charged once a year, on the anniversary of the purchase.

## 10. Exporting and deleting data

The Owner can export the whole workspace (dashboards, datasets definitions and settings) as a ZIP file from **Settings → Workspace → Export**. Data from your sources is not included: Kestrel stores only the cached results needed to display dashboards.

When the Owner deletes a workspace, it is first disabled for 30 days. During that period it can be restored by contacting support. After 30 days it is deleted permanently and cannot be recovered.

Requests about personal data (access, correction, deletion) can be sent to privacy@kestrel.

Seats can be added at any time. Added seats are charged immediately, pro-rated to the end of the current billing period.

An invoice is issued for every charge and sent by e-mail to the billing contact of the workspace. Invoices can also be downloaded from **Settings → Plan → Invoices**.
